description: This file defines the GroupedData class and related functions for performing aggregation operations on Spark DataFrames, created via groupBy. It includes methods for aggregation, counting, averaging, min, max, sum, and pivot operations, with support for Spark Connect and pandas UDFs.

classes.name: GroupedData
classes.description: A class providing aggregation methods on DataFrames grouped by groupBy, supporting various aggregation functions and pivot operations.

methods.name: dfapi
methods.description: Decorator to create DataFrame API methods that invoke corresponding JVM methods.

methods.name: df_varargs_api
methods.description: Decorator for DataFrame API methods accepting variable arguments, converting them to JVM sequences.

methods.name: agg
methods.description: Compute aggregates on grouped data, supporting multiple input types and aggregation functions.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Count the number of records in each group.

methods.name: mean
methods.description: Compute the mean of specified columns for each group.

methods.name: avg
methods.description: Alias for mean; compute average of specified columns.

methods.name: max
methods.description: Compute maximum values for specified columns in each group.

methods.name: min
methods.description: Compute minimum values for specified columns in each group.

methods.name: sum
methods.description: Compute sum of specified columns in each group.

methods.name: pivot
methods.description: Pivot a column of the DataFrame and perform aggregation, optionally specifying pivot values.
